_DESIGN_RULE: Each turn rolls a SEVERITY: quiet (no objection at all), standard, heavy (1.5x damage), or rider (damage plus the rider effect). So an objection that has a rider usually behaves as plain damage - the rider is occasional. Weights live in engine DEFAULT_CFG. Objections also belong to a CATEGORY, and counter cards answer the category, not the specific objection. That way a new objection dropped into an existing category is immediately counterable by cards that already exist, instead of silently being uncounterable. Categories: price, doubt, stall.
